title: Eventual free image and canonical finite residue generators
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E a finite normed Q_ℓ-extension, X topologically noetherian, R_X the integral coefficient ring [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients], and P a locally finitely presented internal R_X-module. There exists N such that image(ℓ^N id_P) is pro-etale locally finite free and B(cokernel(ℓ^N id_P)) is pro-etale locally finite free, where B is the actual canonical free-generator construction [lem-weil-pbc-module-object-free-generators]. This does not assert existence of a resolution of P.

theorem integral_lfp_eventual_free_image
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (CondensedRing.integralCoeff ℓ E) X))
    (hP : IsLocallyFinitelyPresented
      (condensedRingObj (CondensedRing.integralCoeff ℓ E) X) P) :
    ∃ N : ℕ,
      (∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
        Mod.IsFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
          (condensedRingObj (CondensedRing.integralCoeff ℓ E) X))
          (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj
            (image ((ℓ ^ N) • 𝟙 P)))) ∧
      (∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
        Mod.IsFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
          (condensedRingObj (CondensedRing.integralCoeff ℓ E) X))
          (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj
            (moduleObjectFreeGenerators _ (cokernel ((ℓ ^ N) • 𝟙 P)))))
